draw_coco_skeleton: draw a COCO 17-joint skeleton on an image from 2D keypoints using Vis_CocoSkeleton
draw_bbox_xywh: draw a bounding box on an image given xywh coordinates using Vis_Bbox_XYWH
draw_h36m_skeleton: draw a Human3.6M 16/17/32-joint skeleton on an image using Vis_Skeleton_2D_H36m
draw_densepose: visualize DensePose annotations with colored keypoints and hand/face bounding boxes using Vis_Densepose
display_image: display a numpy array or PIL image in an OpenCV window using ImShow
